name: omp-autocomplete-dropup
description: oh-my-pi extension: show the prompt autocomplete dropdown above the input, overlaid on the transcript, so the input never moves
author: Jere Toivonen

mode.description: overlay: draw the list over the transcript above the input; inline: insert it above the input and push the transcript up

scrollbackRestore.description: When rows the list uncovered in terminal scrollback are restored (a full history replay): after typing pauses, or only when the list closes

scrollbackRestoreDelayMs.description: Typing pause before a typing-pause restore runs
